run_docstring_visualization_server: run the docstring generation visualization web application on a configurable host and port
run_server_with_debug: run the docstring visualization Flask server in debug mode with SocketIO support
run_server_on_custom_port: run the docstring generation visualization web application on a custom port and host
create_flask_app_with_socketio: create a Flask application with SocketIO for visualizing the docstring generation process
run_main_entry_point: run the main entry point that parses CLI args and starts the visualization server
